review.notes: Extracted and reviewed per member in the dense-supplemental-composite-reference sidecar (slide text units, five embedded images, 33 sampled video frames). Slide text restates the article and adds examination, clinic follow-up and current medicines, recorded as typed supplement facts. The five slide images are journal branding and are not patient data; the angiography, MRI, echo and ventriculography clips are patient imaging. Thumbs.db is a Windows thumbnail cache and was not reviewed.
limitations: Videos were reviewed as frames sampled every 1 s; frames between samples, continuous motion and audio were not reviewed.
